title: In-Place Home Resale Vacant-Home Obligations and Winterization
content:
**Program terms — vacant homes on In-Place Home Resale files.**

1. **Occupancy reports.** The seller must report when the home becomes vacant or occupied again, and the occupancy recorded on the file governs vacant-home charges.
2. *Retired, no longer in force:* the clause under which, while the file is opened, listed or under contract and the home is vacant, the monthly vacant-home check was charged at the package's monthly check fee for each month or part month, on the first day of the month or the day the home became vacant, with no charge where the package includes the check. That clause is superseded by the current basis for the monthly vacant-home check charge.
3. **Winterization.** At Cedar Hollow and Conestoga Meadows a home vacant at any time during the package's winterization months must be winterized once per winter, charged at the package's winterization fee on the winterization date. No winterization is charged at the other communities or where the package's winterization fee is 0.00.

The package's monthly check fee and winterization fee remain the package figures; only clause 2 is retired.

## Winterization: points of judgement (hypothetical homes)

| Community | Vacant during | Package winterization fee | Winterization charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cedar Hollow | December | 185.00 | once that winter, 185.00 on the winterization date |
| Conestoga Meadows | late October to mid-November | 185.00 | once that winter (vacant during November) |
| Conestoga Meadows | June to September only | 185.00 | none (not vacant in a winterization month) |
| Saguaro Vista | January | 185.00 | none (not one of the two communities) |
| Cedar Hollow | February | 0.00 | none (fee is 0.00) |

The winterization months are November through March on every package.

superseded_clauses: While the file is opened, listed or under contract and the home is vacant, a vacant-home check is required each calendar month and charged at vacant_home_check_fee_monthly for each month or part month (resale_msr_vacant_months), on the first day of the month or the day the home became vacant; where vacant_home_check_included is true no charge is posted.
